description: A dense table of contents with dot leaders (20 dots in a row per entry) — tests the absence of merging and the dot-leader hint (BlockKind:'table').

expected.note: Construction fact: 12 lines, each 'Title ....(20 dots).... N', on its own Y (700..480). Each line contains a run of 20 dots (>= 5 required by the hint). buildSemanticBlocks() should classify each block (a line) as 'table' through the dot-leader rule, regardless of the font role.
